pending_interview.category: System design (general) — scalability patterns; designing common systems like a URL shortener, rate limiter, chat system, notification system
pending_interview.question: You are asked to design a rate limiter — a system that controls how many requests a client can make to an API within a given time window, rejecting or throttling requests that exceed the limit. Walk through your design end-to-end: what data you need to store, where and how you store it, which rate-limiting algorithm you would choose and why, how you handle the system at scale across multiple servers, and what tradeoffs you are accepting. Assume the system needs to handle millions of API clients with very low added latency.
